source: BSEH HTET Information Bulletin, Annexure-I, Level-III (PGT), Parts I-IV. Questions follow the BSEH class IX-XII syllabus, difficulty up to PG level.

units.name: A. Computer system and office software

topics.name: Computer system and CPU
topics.syl: History, generations, characteristics, advantages and limitations, applications and types of a computer system. CPU, ALU and CU, input/output devices.

topics.name: Memory
topics.syl: Units of memory, types of memory.

topics.name: Programming languages and microprocessor
topics.syl: Classification of programming language: high level language, machine level language. History, architecture and characteristics of microprocessor.

topics.name: Encoding and number systems
topics.syl: Encoding schemes and number system: ASCII, UNICODE, number system and conversions.

topics.name: Software and operating system
topics.syl: System software (operating system: its need and functions, compiler, interpreter, assembler), application software, utility software, device drivers.

topics.name: MS Windows
topics.syl: Desktop, taskbar, icons, This PC, Recycle Bin, File Explorer, Edge browser, cut, copy, paste, theme and background.

topics.name: MS Word
topics.syl: Components, formatting, alignment, indents, borders and shading, symbols, shapes, clip art, WordArt, headers and footers, tables, page setup, printing.

topics.name: MS Excel
topics.syl: Components, workbook, worksheet, formatting, cell address, cell pointer, active cell, range of cells, text, formulas, date/time, charts, types and components of charts, creating charts, printing. Functions: SUM(), AVERAGE(), MAX(), MIN(), COUNT().

topics.name: MS PowerPoint
topics.syl: Components, elements of a slide, creating and saving a presentation, slide layouts, slide views, formatting, clip art, pictures, shapes, headers/footers and slide numbers, animation schemes, sound effects, slide show.

units.name: B. Problem solving, software engineering, Python, society and HTML

topics.name: Problem solving, algorithms and flowcharts
topics.syl: Problem solving cycle: analyse, design, coding, implementation and testing. Need of algorithm, designing algorithms using flowcharts. Concept and need of programming. Program constructs: sequence, selection and recurrence.

topics.name: SDLC
topics.syl: Major stages in SDLC: requirement gathering and analysis (survey), investigation and fact recording (feasibility study), software design, development (coding), testing, implementation, maintenance.

topics.name: Software testing
topics.syl: Black box and white box testing. Levels of testing: unit, integration, system and acceptance testing.

topics.name: Python basics and control structures
topics.syl: Features of Python, interactive and script mode, structure of a program, identifiers, keywords, constants, variables, operators and precedence, data types, statements, expressions, comments, input and output, type conversion, debugging. Control structures: sequence, selection and repetition.

topics.name: Python functions and strings
topics.syl: Need of functions, user defined functions, built-in functions. Strings: initialising and accessing strings, string operations.

topics.name: Python lists, tuples and dictionaries
topics.syl: List operations. Tuples: creating, initialising, accessing elements, operations. Dictionary: key-value pairs, mutability, creating, initialising, dictionary operations.

topics.name: Emerging trends
topics.syl: Artificial intelligence, machine learning, natural language processing, robotics, big data, data science, Internet of Things, sensors, smart cities, cloud computing, grid computing, blockchain, 5G network, e-commerce.

topics.name: Cyber security
topics.syl: Computer virus, malware, adware, worms, Trojan, ransomware, spyware, hackers and crackers, safety measures, identity protection, proper use of passwords, confidentiality of information.

topics.name: Digital footprints, cyber law and health
topics.syl: Etiquettes of net surfing and social media, intellectual property rights (IPR), cyber crime and cyber laws, hacking, phishing, cyber bullying, Indian IT Act, cyber crime prevention. Health problems from technology use, such as impact on eyes.

topics.name: HTML
topics.syl: History of HTML, text editor, basic structure of an HTML page, creating and saving, opening in a browser, container and empty elements, HTML elements, text formatting, lists, images, tables and links.

units.name: C. Database, networks, internet, C++ and data structures

topics.name: Database concepts and normalisation
topics.syl: Need and advantages of a database, files, fields and records, need of normalisation, normal forms.

topics.name: MS Access
topics.syl: Features, components, data types, elements of an Access database, creating/opening a database, primary key, creating tables in Datasheet and Design view, viewing, editing and printing tables.

topics.name: SQL
topics.syl: Advantages, data types, commands, clauses, functions.

topics.name: Transmission media and wireless
topics.syl: Transmission media (guided and unguided), wired/wireless communication, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, cloud computing (public and private).

topics.name: Computer networks
topics.syl: Computer network, networking and its need, types of computer networks, network models and their protocols.

topics.name: Internet and web
topics.syl: Internet, its history and working, requirements, firewalls, World Wide Web, web browsers, web servers, web portal, website, search engines, URL, web page, e-mail, blogs, newsgroups, video conferencing.

topics.name: Internet protocols
topics.syl: TCP/IP, FTP, TELNET, SMTP, HTTP, HTTPS, POP3.

topics.name: C++: OOP concepts
topics.syl: Object, class, encapsulation, data hiding/abstraction, inheritance/reusability, polymorphism/overloading.

topics.name: C++: data types, loops, arrays and structures
topics.syl: Data types, operators and expressions, control statements and loops. Arrays (1D and 2D) and structures: structure variables, array of structures, passing structure members to functions.

topics.name: C++: classes, friend, constructors
topics.syl: Class declaration, data members and member functions, private and public members, functions inside and outside the class, nesting member functions, scope resolution (::) operator, arrays in a class, friend function, constructor and destructor.

topics.name: C++: inheritance
topics.syl: Base class, derived class, visibility modes, types of inheritance.

topics.name: Data structures
topics.syl: Data, data item, data structure, stack (push and pop), linear queue (insertion and deletion), array sorting. Past papers also ask trees and graphs.

topics.name: Teaching of computer science
topics.syl: Subject related pedagogy.

topics.name: Development and learning
topics.syl: Concept of development and its relationship with learning, principles of development, influence of heredity and environment.

topics.name: Socialisation
topics.syl: Socialisation processes: social world and children (teacher, parents, peers).

topics.name: Piaget, Kohlberg and Vygotsky
topics.syl: Piaget, Kohlberg and Vygotsky: constructs and critical perspectives.

topics.name: Freud and Erikson, personality
topics.syl: Freud's psychosexual development theory, Erikson's theory of psychosocial development.

topics.name: Adolescence and mental health
topics.syl: Psychology of learners aged 14-17 (nature of the test).

topics.name: Child-centred and progressive education
topics.syl: Concepts of child-centred and progressive education.

topics.name: Intelligence
topics.syl: Critical perspective of the construct of intelligence, multi-dimensional intelligence.

topics.name: Language, thought and gender
topics.syl: Language and thought. Gender as a social construct; gender roles, gender bias and educational practice.

topics.name: Individual differences
topics.syl: Individual differences among learners, differences based on diversity of language, caste, gender, community, religion etc.

topics.name: Assessment and CCE
topics.syl: Assessment for learning and assessment of learning, school-based assessment, continuous and comprehensive evaluation. Framing questions to assess readiness, enhance learning and critical thinking, and assess achievement.

units.name: B. Inclusive education, learning and pedagogy

topics.name: Inclusive education and special needs
topics.syl: Inclusive education, children with special needs, learners from disadvantaged and deprived backgrounds, learning difficulties and impairment, talented, creative and specially abled learners.

topics.name: How children learn
topics.syl: How children think and learn; why children fail in school. Basic processes of teaching and learning, children's learning strategies, learning as a social activity. Child as a problem solver and scientific investigator. Alternative conceptions, children's errors as steps in learning. Bandura's social learning.

topics.name: Cognition, emotion and motivation
topics.syl: Cognition and emotions. Motivation and learning. Personal and environmental factors in learning.

topics.name: Psychology basics and methods
topics.syl: Not listed by name; asked in past papers.

topics.name: अपठित गद्यांश / पद्यांश
topics.syl: One unseen passage (prose, drama or poem) with questions on comprehension, inference, grammar and verbal ability.

topics.name: हिन्दी शिक्षण
topics.syl: Learning and acquisition, principles of language teaching, role of listening and speaking, function of language, role of grammar, challenges of a diverse classroom, language difficulties, errors and disorders, language skills, teaching-learning materials (textbook, multimedia, multilingual resources).

units.name: वर्ण और शब्द-रचना (Grammar and verbal ability)

topics.name: वर्ण विचार
topics.syl: Grammar and verbal ability: वर्ण, स्वर, व्यंजन, उच्चारण स्थान.

topics.name: वर्तनी (मानक हिन्दी)
topics.syl: Grammar and verbal ability: शुद्ध वर्तनी, मानक हिन्दी.

topics.name: सन्धि
topics.syl: Grammar and verbal ability: स्वर, व्यंजन और विसर्ग सन्धि.

topics.name: समास
topics.syl: Grammar and verbal ability: समास के भेद, समास-विग्रह.

topics.name: उपसर्ग और प्रत्यय
topics.syl: Grammar and verbal ability: शब्द-निर्माण.

topics.name: संज्ञा, लिंग, वचन, कारक
topics.syl: Grammar and verbal ability.

topics.name: सर्वनाम
topics.syl: Grammar and verbal ability.

topics.name: विशेषण
topics.syl: Grammar and verbal ability.

topics.name: क्रिया, काल, वाच्य, अव्यय
topics.syl: Grammar and verbal ability.

units.name: शब्द ज्ञान और वाक्य (Vocabulary and sentences)

topics.name: शब्द ज्ञान: पर्याय, विलोम, एक शब्द
topics.syl: Verbal ability: पर्यायवाची, विलोम, अनेक शब्दों के लिए एक शब्द, शब्द-युग्म.

topics.name: मुहावरे और लोकोक्तियाँ
topics.syl: Verbal ability.

topics.name: वाक्य
topics.syl: Grammar and verbal ability: वाक्य के भेद, वाक्य शुद्धि.

topics.name: Unseen passage
topics.syl: One unseen prose passage (discursive, literary, narrative or scientific) with questions on comprehension, grammar and verbal ability.

topics.name: English teaching
topics.syl: Learning and acquisition, principles of language teaching, listening and speaking, role of grammar, teaching a diverse classroom, language difficulties and errors, language skills, teaching-learning materials.

topics.name: Grammar
topics.syl: Tenses, articles, prepositions, parts of speech, voice and narration, sentence ordering, error spotting.

topics.name: Vocabulary and idioms
topics.syl: Synonyms, antonyms, one-word substitution, idioms and phrasal verbs.

topics.name: History, culture, art and literature
topics.syl: Haryana related history, literature, culture, art and traditions.

topics.name: Geography and environment
topics.syl: Geography and environment of Haryana.

topics.name: Civics and administration
topics.syl: Civics of Haryana.

topics.name: Welfare schemes
topics.syl: Welfare schemes of the Haryana Government.

topics.name: Current affairs, sports and awards
topics.syl: Haryana current affairs.

topics.name: Analogy, classification and series
topics.syl: Semantic, symbolic/number and figural analogy, classification and series, Venn diagrams, embedded figures.

topics.name: Coding-decoding and word building
topics.syl: Coding and decoding, word building, small and capital letters/numbers coding, indexing, address and date matching.

topics.name: Relations, directions, ranking and calendar
topics.syl: Relationship concepts, space orientation, problem solving, arithmetical reasoning.

topics.name: Logic and non-verbal reasoning
topics.syl: Statement and conclusion, syllogism, drawing inferences, punched hole and paper folding, figural pattern completion, critical thinking, emotional and social intelligence.

topics.name: Numbers and simplification
topics.syl: Whole numbers, decimals, fractions, relationships between numbers, square roots, elementary surds.

topics.name: Percentage, profit-loss and interest
topics.syl: Percentage, interest, profit and loss, discount.

topics.name: Ratio, average, partnership and mixture
topics.syl: Ratio and proportion, averages, partnership business, mixture and alligation.

topics.name: Time, work and distance
topics.syl: Time and distance, time and work.

topics.name: Algebra
topics.syl: Basic algebraic identities, graphs of linear equations.

topics.name: Geometry, mensuration and trigonometry
topics.syl: Triangles and their centres, congruence and similarity, circles, chords and tangents, quadrilaterals, regular polygons, prism, cone, cylinder, sphere, hemisphere, cuboid, pyramid, trigonometric ratios, degree and radian, identities, heights and distances.

topics.name: Data interpretation
topics.syl: Histogram, frequency polygon, bar diagram and pie chart.
